definition.name: hayashi_algorithm
definition.definition: Hayashi's pure state tomography algorithm (1998): Given n copies of an unknown pure state |psi> in C^d, perform the POVM {M_v = (d[n]/d[n+1]) |v><v|^{tensor n} tensor |v><v|} on the symmetric subspace Sym^{n+1}(C^d), where d[n] = dim(Sym^n(C^d)). The POVM is indexed by unit vectors |v> in C^d (continuous family). The outcome |v> is the estimate. The expected squared overlap is E[|<v|psi>|^2] = (n+1)/(n+d), which approaches 1 as n/d -> infinity.
